description.value: Momo Sushi Colwood is a Japanese sushi restaurant on Goldstream Avenue in Colwood, situated along a busy Westshore corridor accessible from Victoria's regional trail network. The restaurant emphasizes fresh ingredients in a casual sit-down setting and accepts table reservations as well as online orders. It offers a convenient meal stop for cyclists passing through the Colwood–Langford area.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at momosushicolwood.ca is accessible and provides authoritative contact details absent from OSM: address 310 Goldstream Ave, Victoria BC V9B 2W3 and phone (250) 474-2828. The website consistently uses the name 'Momo Sushi Colwood' rather than the OSM name 'Momo Sushi', which is flagged as a discrepancy. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the website content, so all required criteria and nearly all optional amenities are null; online ordering language supports a Takeout value of true.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records this business as 'Momo Sushi' but the website consistently and prominently uses 'Momo Sushi Colwood'; OSM node should be updated.
Address and phone are absent from OSM tags; both values sourced solely from website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate, apparently active restaurant with confirmed address and phone, but none of the required WWC criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from available website content; on-site or direct-contact verification is needed before a directory listing can be justified.
